reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the MiCA white paper (Parts B.3 and D.9) states that all EURI holder funds in the Luxembourg 2003 Act fiduciary estate are held in cash and/or low-risk cash equivalents on a one-for-one basis. Banking Circle's official launch release independently states the same cash-or-cash-equivalents, segregated, bankruptcy-remote posture. Eurite marketing pages and FAQ still say pure 'cash' in a fiduciary reserve account and 1:1 euro cash minting, which is a narrower marketing framing than the legal white-paper investment set; no public dated EY composition schedule splits cash versus cash-equivalent weights. Replaces the prior unsupported 100% pure bank-deposit cash slice with the disclosed cash/cash-equivalent fiduciary basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Banking Circle EURI MiCA white-paper fiduciary reserve policy; cash vs cash-equivalent weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full reserve envelope is identified as EUR cash and/or low-risk cash equivalents in the EURI fiduciary estate, but cash versus cash-equivalent weights, instrument identities, maturities, account-level placement, and provider shares are not published. About-page EY attestation claims are not accompanied by a dated public composition examination.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: White paper and product site describe a Luxembourg 2003 Act fiduciary estate, segregation from Banking Circle own assets, and bankruptcy remoteness for Safeguarded Customer Funds; holders' rights are against the fiduciary estate rather than Banking Circle as a whole. Account-level placement, any third-party sub-custodians, provider shares, and rehypothecation terms are not published.
